newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates hover at lower levels. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates hover at lower levels. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money rates hovered at lower levels on Tuesday amid surplus funds in the banking system but may rise because of an open market operation set for Wednesday.

"As expected, the overnight market traded in the range of 2.50 and four percent," one dealer said, adding that the market was inactive and most of the deals were rolled over at the same levels. One-month (corrects from three-month) funds were traded at 13.25 percent.
Overnight rates may rise on Wednesday if the State (central) Bank of Pakistan chooses to pick up a substantial amount in its weekly open market operation, the dealer said.
